purpose: Original concept atlases; inspired art directions, not assets copied from RimWorld or Stoneshard

prompts.rimworld: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent game sprite atlas for an interactive HTML Caves of Qud Joppa prototype. Create an exact uniform 4 by 4 grid of sixteen isolated sprites on a truly transparent background. Square 1024 x 1024 overall, each cell 256 x 256; no gutters or grid lines. Place each sprite centered in its own cell with a generous transparent margin; every sprite fully contained in its cell. Consistent orthographic slightly elevated view, south-facing fronts, warm light from upper left. Original art inspired by RimWorld's clean outlined, flat illustrated colony-game readability, olive green plants, sun-bleached ochre and clay, dark brown fine outlines. Qud science fantasy village with reeds and rusty salvage, not medieval Europe. No text, no UI, no labels, no ground under objects, no cast shadows, no floor backgrounds. EXACT cell order, left to right: Row 1: low leafy watervine crop; tall brinestalk reed clump; broad thorny dogthorn tree with trunk; starapple tree with a few red fruit. Row 2: full-body farmer in ochre robe; full-body bearded tinkerer in muted teal with tools; full-body armored village warden; full-body trader in burgundy robe. Row 3: round woven basket; simple bed with rolled cloth blanket; rough wooden table; rusty metal workbench with scrap tools. Row 4: woven brinestalk wall panel with wooden posts viewed from above and front; closed reed-and-wood door; pile of rusty metal scrap; small ancient stone shrine. Make a usable organized sprite atlas, not a scene, collage, card set or concept painting.
prompts.stoneshard: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent game sprite atlas for an interactive HTML Caves of Qud Joppa prototype. Create an exact uniform 4 by 4 grid of sixteen isolated sprites on a truly transparent background. Square 1024 x 1024 overall, each cell 256 x 256; no gutters or grid lines. Place each sprite centered in its own cell with a generous transparent margin; every sprite fully contained in its cell. Consistent orthographic slightly elevated top-down world view with side-facing full-body characters and south-facing wall fronts. Original detailed pixel art inspired by Stoneshard: deliberate crisp pixels, rich but restrained earthy colors, textured foliage, intricate worn materials, believable volume. No smooth digital painting. Olive green plants, straw ochre, rust, ancient science-fantasy village, not European medieval houses. Warm light from upper left. No text, UI, labels, ground planes, cast shadows or floor backgrounds. EXACT cell order, left to right: Row 1: low leafy watervine crop; tall brinestalk reed clump; broad thorny dogthorn tree with visible trunk; starapple tree with red fruit. Row 2: full-body farmer in ochre robe looking to the side; full-body bearded tinkerer in muted teal with tools looking sideways; full-body armored village warden looking sideways; full-body trader in burgundy robe looking sideways. Row 3: round woven basket; simple bed with rolled cloth blanket; rough wooden table; rusty metal workbench with scrap tools. Row 4: woven brinestalk wall panel with wooden posts viewed above and front; closed reed-and-wood door; pile of rusty metal scrap; small ancient carved stone shrine. Make a usable organized sprite atlas, not a village scene, collage or concept painting.
